notes: General assessment guidance, not verified engineering specifications. Human review required.

infrastructure.intake: Assess endpoints, locations, current topology, bandwidth and redundancy needs.
infrastructure.planning: Document the existing network and cabling, capacity, power, cooling and change windows.
infrastructure.escalation: Require an engineer to validate topology and installation plans.

software-web.intake: Identify business workflows, users, access roles, integrations and content ownership.
software-web.planning: Define requirements, acceptance tests, hosting and maintenance responsibilities.
software-web.escalation: Review privacy, security and implementation scope before quoting.

it-amc.intake: Count devices, sites, support hours, incident patterns and current inventory.
it-amc.planning: Agree escalation, exclusions, response targets and preventive maintenance.
it-amc.escalation: Confirm contract terms with the service team.

cloud.intake: Inventory workloads, data sensitivity, dependencies and recovery objectives.
cloud.planning: Compare deployment options, migration stages, costs and rollback plans.
cloud.escalation: Engineer validates configuration, access and compliance.

security.intake: Establish asset scope, authorization, current controls and incident symptoms.
security.planning: Prioritize defensive assessment, least privilege, updates and backups.
security.escalation: Escalate active incidents to an authorized security specialist. Do not attempt intrusion or bypass.

data-backup.intake: Identify protected data, retention, acceptable data loss and downtime.
data-backup.planning: Plan isolated backups and tested restores with access restrictions.
data-backup.escalation: Validate recovery objectives and test restoration before relying on backups.

it-procurement.intake: Identify workloads, quantities, compatibility, budget range and lifecycle.
it-procurement.planning: Compare requirements, warranty, support and total cost of ownership.
it-procurement.escalation: Verify availability and supplier quotations separately.

smart-office.intake: Identify room use, access needs, privacy requirements and existing systems.
smart-office.planning: Assess network coverage, power, interoperability and consent for monitoring.
smart-office.escalation: Arrange authorized site assessment and privacy review.

special-projects.intake: Clarify project goals, sites, users, temporary or permanent scope and dates.
special-projects.planning: Identify dependencies, support ownership and acceptance criteria.
special-projects.escalation: Obtain engineer review and a scoped proposal.

video-conferencing.intake: Identify room size, seating, conferencing platform, acoustics and display needs.
video-conferencing.planning: Assess microphone coverage, camera framing, connectivity and accessibility.
video-conferencing.escalation: Arrange specialist site survey before equipment selection.

auditorium-av.intake: Identify capacity, layout, event type, acoustics and existing equipment.
auditorium-av.planning: Assess sightlines, audio coverage, control, rigging and power requirements.
auditorium-av.escalation: Specialists must validate structural, electrical and acoustic design.

professional-sound.intake: Identify venue, audience, program material, acoustics and sound coverage.
professional-sound.planning: Assess existing equipment, signal flow, power and operating constraints.
professional-sound.escalation: Qualified specialists verify SPL, electrical load and safe installation.

av-maintenance.intake: Inventory equipment, age, symptoms, usage and support requirements.
av-maintenance.planning: Plan authorized inspection, preventive care and service scheduling.
av-maintenance.escalation: Refer electrical, rigging and hardware repairs to qualified technicians.

data-recovery.intake: Identify storage type, symptoms, recent events and data importance without filenames.
data-recovery.planning: Stop using failing media where practical. Avoid writing, formatting, repair utilities or opening a drive.
data-recovery.escalation: Arrange specialist assessment. Recovery feasibility and cost cannot be guaranteed.
